findings.reproduction: Patterns shaped like (?:(?=a)a|b) under repetition incorrectly flattened an alternative containing an assertion.
findings.fix: Only flatten true consuming atoms; alternatives containing assertions or sequences use the general executor.

findings.reproduction: Create a scanner or iterator on a writable bytearray or memoryview, obtain a result, edit the underlying bytes, and obtain the next result.
findings.fix: Batch immutable inputs; request one record at a time for writable buffers so every next call observes edits.

findings.reproduction: Resize a bytearray after matching, pass an invalid integer subject, or use a whitespace/comment expression with VERBOSE enabled.
findings.fix: Clamp match slices to the current buffer length, validate buffer support before reporting a text/bytes mismatch, and never select the literal path for VERBOSE patterns.
